linen-canvas.$description: Linen Canvas — Page background — the warm off-white base all sections sit on; this is the dominant surface of the entire site

bone-card.$description: Bone Card — Card and elevated surface background — slightly lighter than the canvas so cards read as lifted paper without shadow

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Reserved for inverted text on dark buttons, product mockup surfaces, and high-contrast inline elements

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary action button fill, heading text, hairline borders, and the announcement bar — the high-contrast workhorse

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Secondary text, icon strokes, and soft border definition where pure black would feel too heavy

sage-mint.$description: Sage Mint — Organic highlight wash for avatar backgrounds, tag pills, and the soft glow behind recognition cards — the only chromatic color, used like a botanical accent

ivypresto-headline.$description: Display and hero headlines only. This high-contrast didone-flavored serif at 74px (hero) and 54px (section) is the brand's signature voice — generous letterforms, tight leading, and weight 600 carry authority without feeling corporate. Mixed inline with circular avatar images to embed people into the sentence itself.

rubik.$description: All non-headline text: subheadings, body, button labels, form labels, badges. Weight 400 for body paragraphs, 500–600 for buttons and tags, 700 sparingly for emphasized stats. Friendly geometric sans balances the editorial serif above it.

arial.$description: Small UI labels and icon-adjacent micro-copy where a system font suffices
